messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT alert -> SLO burn detected for model-serving-prod: burn_rate=2.4, window=5m, affected_routes=3, customers=low. Link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/2234567890 :rotating_light:
Alex C: saw it. looks like a short spike, but paging fired. were we expecting traffic surge?
Priya S: not from prod load tests. I'm checking the route list now. could be a batch job hitting embeddings.
Mateo R: logs show a burst of long-context requests on /v1/generate-large around 23:04 UTC. attaching a quick query: ```logql: range(|> filter route="/v1/generate-large" | count_over_time(1m))```
Jordan L: thanks mateo. is the current paging criteria 5m burn>2.0?
SRE-Tools: paging rule: slo_burn_5m > 2.0 AND slo_burn_1h > 1.2 triggered.
Alex C: hmm paging threshold seems aggressive for noisy short bursts. We should avoid waking on transient spikes.
Priya S: agree. Propose: move to multi-window trigger where 5m needs to be >3.0 AND 1h>1.1 OR 6h>1.05. Also add customer-impact filter (unique_customers_affected>5) to avoid paging for single-tenant misbehaviour.
Mateo R: customer-impact filter is good. But some high-SLA customers with single tenant could be critical. Maybe tiered paging: enterprise customers force page at lower thresholds.
Alex C: yes — add `customer_tier == enterprise` clause. For others use relaxed thresholds.
Jordan L: +1. Also want a quick dashboard to triage: per-route burn, top routes by contribution, 5m/1h/6h windows, and p50/p95 latency. I'll stand one up unless someone already on it.
Priya S: I'll start building the dashboard in Grafana. I'll base on the `slo.burn` and `slo.budget` metrics and include a panel for correlated infra metrics (gpu_util, queue_depth).
SRE-Tools: Note: current alert rule in terraform: ```yaml
alert "SLOBurn_5m" {
  expr = "sum(rate(slo_burn{env=\"prod\"}[5m])) > 2"
  for = "0m"
  labels = { severity = "page" }
}
```
Alex C: let's propose a new rule draft: ```yaml
alert "SLOBurn_MultiWindow" {
  expr = "(slo_burn{env=\"prod\",customer_tier=\"enterprise\"}[5m] > 2.5 and increase(slo_burn[5m]) > 0) or (slo_burn[1h] > 1.2 and slo_burn[5m] > 1.5)"
  for = "5m"
  labels = { severity = "page" }
}
```
Priya S: prefer `for = 5m` on page alerts to reduce noise. For notify-only alerts keep 1m.
Mateo R: can we add a suppressor for recurring noisy routes: a cooldown so if route X paged in last 30m then suppress pages for 20m unless escalation.
Jordan L: we already have incident-flood protection in the bot, but it's per-alert not per-route. Adding route cooldown is smart.
Alex C: action items: 1) Priya to create Grafana dashboard and link to runbook. 2) Mateo to prepare terraform patch for multi-window rule + customer_tier clauses. 3) Jordan to prototype route-cooldown suppressor in the bot. 4) I will update paging policy doc with tier decision.
Priya S: starting dashboard now. Will include link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-burn
Mateo R: I've forked infra-alerts repo, drafting a PR: https://git.internal/infra-alerts/pulls/87 — will add tests for multi-window semantics.
Jordan L: I'll add a new suppressor lambda to the bot and test in staging.
SRE-Tools: Incident note: impact assessed as low (no widespread 5xxs), customer_count=2 high-volume sessions; automated fallback to smaller model kicked in at 23:07 and reduced burn.
Alex C: Good — fallback behaved correctly. Still want the noise sculpting changes to avoid wakeups. Priya, how long for dashboard?
Priya S: dashboard skeleton in ~30m, full panels + links by EOD.
Mateo R: PR aim: draft by EOD, request review from @Alex C and @Jordan L.
Jordan L: I'll build the suppressor and run in staging tomorrow morning.
Alex C: ok. Post-incident follow-up: we should run a 48h alert-noise sweep next week to find other noisy routes and recommend quant/kv cache tweaks. I'll create a calendar invite.
Priya S: adding a todo to the runbook to mention cooldown and enterprise overrides.
Mateo R: tagging on-call rotation here: after we merge changes, we should run a controlled deploy during low-traffic window.
Jordan L: noted. I'll update the bot changelog and document suppressor config.
Alex C: thanks team. Closing this thread once PR+dashboard+bot prototype exist. Please update thread with links. :thumbsup:
